# KC Clean Carpets

> Family-owned carpet and floor cleaning company headquartered in Raytown, MO, serving the entire Kansas City metro on both sides of the state line. 5.0-star rated with 135+ Google reviews. Rooms from $45 with upfront pricing. Call (816) 715-1130 or book online in 60 seconds.

KC Clean Carpets uses truck-mounted hot water extraction (what most people call steam cleaning) with eco-friendly, non-toxic solutions safe for kids and pets. Every job is backed by a 100% satisfaction guarantee. Typical homes take 1–2 hours to clean and carpet dries in 4–8 hours. Hours: Monday–Saturday, 8am–8pm. Address: 10409 E 56th St, Raytown, MO 64133.

## Services

- [Carpet Cleaning](https://www.kccleancarpets.com/carpet-cleaning): Hot water extraction, pet stain & odor removal, rooms from $45
- [Area Rug Cleaning](https://www.kccleancarpets.com/rug-cleaning-kansas-city): Onsite low-moisture cleaning for most rugs
- [Upholstery Cleaning](https://www.kccleancarpets.com/upholstery-cleaning): Couches, sectionals, recliners — fabric-code checked before every job
- [Tile & Grout Cleaning](https://www.kccleancarpets.com/tile-grout-cleaning): High-pressure extraction restores grout lines
- [Hardwood Floor Cleaning](https://www.kccleancarpets.com/hardwood-cleaning): pH-balanced, no warping or residue
- [Sandless Floor Refinishing](https://www.kccleancarpets.com/sandless-refinishing): Like-new hardwood in one day, no dust
- [Hardwood Wax Removal](https://www.kccleancarpets.com/wax-removal): Strips yellowed wax buildup
- [Commercial Carpet Cleaning](https://www.kccleancarpets.com/commercial-carpet-cleaning): After-hours service for offices, hotels, medical, retail
